newsitem.title: USA: Four children shot to death in their beds.
newsitem.headline: Four children shot to death in their beds.

text.p: Police were searching on Monday for the father of four children found shot to death in their beds on Sunday night.
All of the children -- aged 10, 13, 14 and 16 -- were sleeping in a bedroom and were shot at least once in the head with a handgun, Police Chief Robin Morse said.
The children's mother, Bertha Satterwhite, found their pajama-clad bodies. She also found a .22 calibre handgun beside a note addressed to her in the house.
Authorities would not release the contents of the note. She and her husband, Johnny Satterwhite, 36, separated a week ago.
A neighbour told police she last saw the children playing in the yard on Thursday and heard the father's pickup truck on Friday. No lights were on in the house all weekend, she said.
